newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca shares tumble after FDA warning.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca shares tumble after FDA warning.

text.p: British drugs company Zeneca Group Plc said on Friday it had received a warning letter from the U.S. FDA after an inspection of the group's UK manufacturing facilities at Macclesfield, in north west England.

The warning states that the U.S. Food and Drugs Administration will not recommend approval of any new applications listing Zeneca as the manufacturer of sterile pharmaceuticals, until reinspections have been carried out and corrections have been undertaken.
A spokesman for Zeneca told Reuters the warning was recieved on February 20 but the company was fully committed to resolving the matter.
"We are confident of resolving the issue, and we are continuing to supply out of Macclesfield," the spokesman said.
"We are working on the problem at the moment and have already met with the FDA officials."
The shares fell 31p to 18.07-1/2 stg in response to the news.
"It will be interesting to see just how bad this turns out to be," said one dealer. "I believe these warnings are quite common," he added.
